sonnet.problem: The punchline repeats the shape of stop 1 card 5 ('I live alone on a cookie planet and I STILL can't get one week with no crisis'). Both are 'Friend, I ... and I STILL ...' self-deprecation lines. Most other story cards also end on the same 'Friend, I ...' self-comparison (stop 1 card 13, stop 2 cards 1, 8 and 9), so the jokes follow a formula.
sonnet.rule: No formula. ... Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.

sonnet.problem: Card 11 already asked whether Solomon's builders worked alone, and the answer revealed that Hiram's builders and the Gebalites helped. Card 12 then retells that same fact, which makes it a recap rather than a new beat. Verse 18 was already asked, so the last story card could have been just the 'story isn't over' line.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
